a1-161.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is the Dog?
a1-161.scenario: Anna asks you (Meg) where the dog and the cat are. The dog is under the bench, and the cat is in front of the gate.
a1-161.prompt: Tell Anna where the dog is and where the cat is.
a1-161.target: A kutya a pad alatt van. A macska a kapu előtt van.
a1-161.english: The dog is under the bench. The cat is in front of the gate.
a1-161.canDo: I can say where something is, like A kutya a pad alatt van and A macska a kapu előtt van.
